SELECT now() AS run_at, 'orders' AS table_name, 'raw_rows' AS check_name, count(*)::numeric AS value
FROM orders

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'orders', 'delivered_without_delivery_date', count(*)::numeric
FROM orders
WHERE lower(btrim(order_status)) = 'delivered'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'orders', 'orders_without_items', count(*)::numeric
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE oi.order_id IS NULL

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'orders', 'orphan_customer_id', count(*)::numeric
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND c.customer_id IS NULL

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'order_items', 'raw_rows', count(*)::numeric
FROM order_items

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'order_items', 'negative_price', count(*)::numeric
FROM order_items
WHERE price < 0

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'order_items', 'zero_price', count(*)::numeric
FROM order_items
WHERE price = 0

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'order_items', 'orphan_product_id', count(*)::numeric
FROM order_items oi
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.product_id IS NOT NULL AND p.product_id IS NULL

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'order_items', 'orphan_seller_id', count(*)::numeric
FROM order_items oi
LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE oi.seller_id IS NOT NULL AND s.seller_id IS NULL

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'order_items', 'exact_duplicates', count(*)::numeric
FROM (
  SELECT order_id, order_item_id, count(*) c
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id, order_item_id
  HAVING count(*) > 1
) d

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'order_payments', 'raw_rows', count(*)::numeric
FROM order_payments

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'order_payments', 'high_value_flag_above_p99', count(*)::numeric
FROM order_payments
WHERE payment_value > (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY payment_value)
  FROM order_payments
)

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'order_payments', 'negative_value', count(*)::numeric
FROM order_payments
WHERE payment_value < 0

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'order_reviews', 'raw_rows', count(*)::numeric
FROM order_reviews

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'order_reviews', 'score_out_of_range', count(*)::numeric
FROM order_reviews
WHERE review_score < 1 OR review_score > 5

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'order_reviews', 'no_comment_message', count(*)::numeric
FROM order_reviews
WHERE review_comment_message IS NULL OR btrim(review_comment_message) = ''

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'customers', 'raw_rows', count(*)::numeric
FROM customers

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'customers', 'repeat_customers_by_unique_id', count(*)::numeric
FROM (
  SELECT customer_unique_id
  FROM customers
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
  HAVING count(*) > 1
) d

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'customers', 'null_zip', count(*)::numeric
FROM customers
WHERE customer_zip_code_prefix IS NULL

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'sellers', 'raw_rows', count(*)::numeric
FROM sellers

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'sellers', 'null_zip', count(*)::numeric
FROM sellers
WHERE seller_zip_code_prefix IS NULL

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'geolocation', 'raw_rows', count(*)::numeric
FROM geolocation

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'geolocation', 'exact_duplicates', count(*)::numeric
FROM (
  SELECT geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng, geolocation_city, geolocation_state, count(*) c
  FROM geolocation
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
  HAVING count(*) > 1
) d

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'geolocation', 'outside_brazil', count(*)::numeric
FROM geolocation
WHERE geolocation_lat NOT BETWEEN -34 AND 6
   OR geolocation_lng NOT BETWEEN -74 AND -32

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'products', 'raw_rows', count(*)::numeric
FROM products

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'products', 'category_without_translation', count(*)::numeric
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND t.product_category_name IS NULL

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'products', 'null_category', count(*)::numeric
FROM products
WHERE product_category_name IS NULL

UNION ALL
SELECT now(), 'products', 'zero_weight', count(*)::numeric
FROM products
WHERE product_weight_g = 0

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        lpad(btrim(geolocation_zip_code_prefix), 5, '0') AS zip_prefix,
        geolocation_lat AS lat,
        geolocation_lng AS lng,
        initcap(translate(
            btrim(geolocation_city),
            'áàãâäéèêëíìîïóòõôöúùûüçÁÀÃÂÄÉÈÊËÍÌÎÏÓÒÕÔÖÚÙÛÜÇ',
            'aaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuucAAAAAEEEEIIIIOOOOOUUUUC'
        )) AS city,
        upper(left(btrim(geolocation_state), 2)) AS state
    FROM geolocation
),
valid_coords AS (
    SELECT zip_prefix, lat, lng, city, state
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE lat BETWEEN -34 AND 6
      AND lng BETWEEN -74 AND -32
),
coords_agg AS (
    SELECT
        zip_prefix,
        avg(lat) AS latitude,
        avg(lng) AS longitude
    FROM valid_coords
    GROUP BY zip_prefix
),
city_state_mode AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (zip_prefix)
        zip_prefix,
        city,
        state
    FROM cleaned
    GROUP BY zip_prefix, city, state
    ORDER BY zip_prefix, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY zip_prefix, city, state) DESC
),
all_zips AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lpad(btrim(customer_zip_code_prefix), 5, '0') AS zip_prefix
    FROM customers
    WHERE customer_zip_code_prefix IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT lpad(btrim(seller_zip_code_prefix), 5, '0') AS zip_prefix
    FROM sellers
    WHERE seller_zip_code_prefix IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT zip_prefix FROM cleaned
)
SELECT
    az.zip_prefix::int AS geo_key,
    az.zip_prefix AS zip_prefix,
    csm.city AS city,
    csm.state AS state,
    ca.latitude AS latitude,
    ca.longitude AS longitude
FROM all_zips az
LEFT JOIN coords_agg ca ON ca.zip_prefix = az.zip_prefix
LEFT JOIN city_state_mode csm ON csm.zip_prefix = az.zip_prefix

UNION ALL

SELECT -1, 'unknown', 'Unknown', 'ZZ', NULL, NULL

WITH all_categories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT product_category_name AS category_pt
    FROM products
    WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT product_category_name AS category_pt
    FROM product_category_name_translation
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        ac.category_pt,
        COALESCE(
            t.product_category_name_english,
            initcap(replace(ac.category_pt, '_', ' '))
        ) AS category_english
    FROM all_categories ac
    LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t
        ON t.product_category_name = ac.category_pt
)
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY category_pt) AS category_key,
    category_pt AS category_name_pt,
    initcap(replace(category_english, '_', ' ')) AS category_name_english
FROM enriched

UNION ALL

SELECT -1 AS category_key, 'desconhecido' AS category_name_pt, 'Unknown' AS category_name_english

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        min(order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS min_date,
        max(order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS max_date
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
),
calendar AS (
    SELECT generate_series(min_date, max_date, interval '1 day')::date AS full_date
    FROM bounds
)
SELECT
    (to_char(full_date, 'YYYYMMDD'))::int AS date_key,
    full_date AS full_date,
    extract(year FROM full_date)::int AS year,
    extract(quarter FROM full_date)::int AS quarter,
    extract(month FROM full_date)::int AS month,
    to_char(full_date, 'FMMonth') AS month_name,
    extract(day FROM full_date)::int AS day,
    extract(isodow FROM full_date)::int AS day_of_week,
    to_char(full_date, 'FMDay') AS day_name,
    extract(week FROM full_date)::int AS week_of_year
FROM calendar

UNION ALL

SELECT
    -1 AS date_key,
    '1900-01-01'::date AS full_date,
    -1 AS year,
    -1 AS quarter,
    -1 AS month,
    'Unknown' AS month_name,
    -1 AS day,
    -1 AS day_of_week,
    'Unknown' AS day_name,
    -1 AS week_of_year

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (btrim(customer_id))
        btrim(customer_id) AS customer_id,
        btrim(customer_unique_id) AS customer_unique_id,
        lpad(btrim(customer_zip_code_prefix), 5, '0') AS zip_prefix,
        initcap(translate(
            btrim(customer_city),
            'áàãâäéèêëíìîïóòõôöúùûüçÁÀÃÂÄÉÈÊËÍÌÎÏÓÒÕÔÖÚÙÛÜÇ',
            'aaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuucAAAAAEEEEIIIIOOOOOUUUUC'
        )) AS customer_city,
        upper(left(btrim(customer_state), 2)) AS customer_state
    FROM customers
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY btrim(customer_id)
)
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY customer_id) AS customer_key,
    customer_id,
    customer_unique_id,
    zip_prefix::int AS geo_key,
    customer_city,
    customer_state
FROM cleaned

UNION ALL

SELECT
    -1 AS customer_key,
    'unknown' AS customer_id,
    'unknown' AS customer_unique_id,
    -1 AS geo_key,
    'Unknown' AS customer_city,
    'ZZ' AS customer_state
